llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese-language test-case generation helper with no bundled code and only user-directed optional output actions.

dimensions.detail: Tool use is limited to creating Feishu documents, uploading to cloud drive, or writing local files only when those tools exist and the user explicitly asks for that output.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only a Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata and no executable installer, dependency declaration, or remote retrieval instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill defaults to Chinese interaction and a Chinese welcome message; this is visible in the artifact and is a usability scope note rather than a security concern.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, credential handling, memory modification, privilege escalation, or automatic file mutation is instructed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and instructions consistently focus on turning user-provided requirements, form rules, approval flows, UI notes, and business rules into structured test cases.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a Chinese-language assistant for producing structured QA test cases. Be aware it may answer in Chinese by default, and only ask it to create Feishu documents, upload files, or write local files when you intend those outputs.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The artifact is entirely Chinese and prescribes a Chinese welcome message, but this is disclosed by the skill text and does not create hidden authority, data access, persistence, or security-relevant behavior.
[AIG static scan] expected: The supplied SARIF results report no findings, which matches the inspected artifact's lack of executable code, remote payloads, privilege requests, or unsafe persistence.
